item.title: Georgia considers financial support for college students who need money most
item.description: Financially strapped college students in Georgia often must drop out for want of money for food and shelter, but their prospects could improve under a new initiative from Gov. Brian Kemp. The post Georgia considers financial support for college students who need money most appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Meet Popcorn, the Children’s Hospital of Georgia’s newest facility dog
item.description: Last November, staff at the Wellstar Golisano Children’s Hospital of Georgia (CHOG) gave a hearty sendoff to Nugget, the golden retriever who helped launch the hospital’s service dog program. Now that she’s retired, there’s a new pup on the block eager to help comfort CHOG’s young patients.
